bio: Fawsley Hall is a luxurious venue in Northamptonshire, the perfect place to enjoy Afternoon Tea. Nestled within picturesque gardens, the hotel's striking architecture and impressive interiors create the perfect backdrop to indulge in Afternoon Tea.  Afternoon Tea at Fawsley Hall Hotel & Spa is served in the Tudor Bar and Lounge, Conservatory or Great Hall, with beautiful views over the gardens and grounds. In warmer months, you can also enjoy Afternoon Tea alfresco. The elegant yet relaxed setting makes it the perfect spot to unwind and indulge in this British tradition.  The Afternoon Tea menu features an array of savoury treats, scones and sweet pastries, along with a wide selection of loose-leaf teas. The talented pastry chefs prepare the scones and cakes freshly each day. The menu is refreshed regularly to celebrate various occasions throughout the year.  Fawsley Hall are also able to cater to a wide range of dietary requirements including gluten-free, vegan and have special children's Afternoon Tea options. Why not upgrade your traditional experience with a glass of Champagne or Prosecco for the height of luxury?
